cells.name: BR opposite passing

measurementContract.coordinateSpace: Native per-cell pixels from top-left; TL/TR/BL/BR.
measurementContract.rootMeaning: Fresh manual hidden pelvis-center X projected to independently visible supporting boot sole in each cell. A 2D registration pivot, not anatomical pelvis or physical ground certification.
measurementContract.groundMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 bottom-exclusive Y in independently chosen supporting-sole-only regions; no shared row assumption.
measurementContract.capMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 minimum Y in independently chosen cap regions excluding rifles.
measurementContract.referenceMethod: Median of four cap-to-individual-supporting-sole spans; one source-wide scale, no per-phase normalization.
measurementContract.sizeLimit: Measured body-span variation of 39px is preserved. Per-cell sole registration improves boot contact without per-phase rescaling.

contactBootDepthEvidence.method: Fresh alpha64 supporting/other-boot regions measured from final tan/brown source; diagnostic values were not reused.

nativePixelEvidence.paddingAssessment: All four pass strict floor16; top margins21/23/20/22 and TRbottom18 fall below32 generation goal. No clipping or cell crossing found.
nativePixelEvidence.coloredRGBAssessment: One saturated colored alpha253 pixel; remaining saturated RGB at alpha<=5 under criterion. No conspicuous broad opaque fringe. Native tool display exaggerates neartransparent RGB.
